# bintables/callfn

> Calling a function value: push the arguments, then call the address in rax.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/callfn.pkg) · translates [std/callfn](../std/callfn.md)

The same convention as [call](call.md): arguments pushed right to left,
popped after the call. The function value is evaluated after the
arguments, and a null one jumps to the panic helper.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when args empty`

```nasm
{f}
test rax, rax
jz __pk_panic_nullfn
call rax
@panic
```

### `emit`

```nasm
{each args reverse}
{it}
push rax
{end}
{f}
test rax, rax
jz __pk_panic_nullfn
call rax
add rsp, {args.stack}
@panic
```

Includes: [bintables/panic](panic.md)
